BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   C. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   D. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   C. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   B. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   D. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   D. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

7. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

9. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   B. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   D. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

11. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   C. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   B. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   D. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   C. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   C. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.

16. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   C. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Networking in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Income Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Statement of Financial Position and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
